MLA Standard: SS.912.A.6.8, SS.912.A.6.10, SS.912.A.6.11

Stimulus: Cold War cause-effect timeline

Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task
This lesson connects domestic anticommunism, containment, alliance systems, and nuclear technology. You should see how Cold War fear shaped both foreign policy and life inside the United States.The early Cold War grew from conflict between the United States and Soviet Union over ideology, security, influence, and the future of Europe and Asia.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.6.8, SS.912.A.6.10, SS.912.A.6.11.

generalfeedback.text: Use the stimulus, identify the evidence, explain the reasoning, and check the mapped standard before finalizing your answer.
